beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: London makes the week visible as a relay among institutional schedule, temporary room, camera, platform, labor, commerce and archive. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: The survival of schedules, films, and interface states shapes which versions of London Fashion Week remain researchable.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The survival of schedules, films, and interface states shapes which versions of London Fashion Week remain researchable. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The live schedule, retained 2020 event page, official video channel, museum collection, and web archive preserve different layers of London Fashion Week under different access and reuse conditions.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The bounded search in G-MEASURE-05 did not confirm a complete public event-level measurement boundary, baseline, and verification method for a future London edition.
